pages.title: Eat Well, Sleep Well
pages.text: Keep $(bold)all six nutrient bars above 50%$() before you sleep and you will wake up with:$(br2)$(c:#52c252)$(li)Regeneration I for 30 seconds$()$(br2)It is a small but meaningful reward for maintaining a consistently balanced diet — not just spiking one bar and ignoring the rest.$(br2)$(italic)Another reason to check your Diet Screen before logging off.$()
